To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a sociotechnical approach is needed to understand workplace safety and the factors that affect it, and that a sociotechnICAL systems approach can be developed by integrating the sociotechnical systems literature, complex systems literature and the safety literature.

(1) a sociotechnical perspective is required to address the complex problem of workplace safety, (2) the sociotechnical system is a multi-level system that includes the work system, the socio-organisatonal context and the external context, and (3) the future challenges for workplace safety include the need to develop a more integrated understanding of the system, and the need to identify the system elements and interactions that are critical to safety.
the sociotechnical systems model of workplace safety is a useful framework for understanding the multi-level and complex system factors that contribute towards workplace safety.

the complex multi-level factors that contribute to safety at work and the challenges that need to be addressed to improve safety at work.
